resources.string: Select a price in euros or dollars on any web page: the bubble instantly shows it in CFA francs.
Turns on \"Instant Converter\" in Settings › Accessibility so the bubble reacts as soon as you select an amount. Nothing is collected or sent anywhere.
If Android says the setting is restricted (app installed from an APK): open App info, tap ⋮ › \"Allow restricted settings\", then come back.
Show the bubble when the phone starts
Please allow \"Display over other apps\" first.

• The bubble sits in a corner of the screen. Drag it to move it: it snaps to the nearest corner.
• On a web page, select an amount ("49,99 €", "$1,299", "15 euros"…): the bubble grows and shows the amount in FCFA.
• Tap anywhere outside the bubble to close it: it shrinks back into its corner.
• Long-press the result to copy it.
• Without automatic detection: copy the amount then tap the bubble, or choose "Convert to FCFA" in the selection menu (⋮).
The bubble is active. Select an amount to convert it.
or copy it, then tap the bubble

Detects the amounts in euros or dollars that you select in any app (web browser, etc.) and shows their value in CFA francs in the floating bubble. Only the selected text is read, locally; nothing is stored or sent.
